clues.text: While among the exiles by the River Kebar, this priest saw the heavens open and visions of God.
The LORD set this prophet in a valley full of dry bones and told him to prophesy to them.
God told this son of Buzi to eat a scroll, and it tasted sweet as honey in his mouth.
When this exiled prophet's wife, the delight of his eyes, died, God told him not to mourn or weep.
In a whirlwind from the north, this exile saw four living creatures, each with four faces and four wings.
God made this exiled priest a watchman for the house of Israel, to give them warning from Him.
God told this prophet to lie on his left side for 390 days, bearing the iniquity of Israel.
